experimental_evidence: EXECUTION GATES COMPLETE; SCIENTIFIC HYPOTHESIS UNTESTED. Released 0.5.1 open-loop trajectories do not replay in RoboCasa 1.0.1, but the official GR00T baseline supplies successful current-runtime rollouts. A4 established exact deterministic one-step branches, action outcome diversity, all three cameras, and multi-level native progress labels. Fixed-half-horizon B0 reconstructed prefixes exactly and produced diverse post-states, but binary success did not vary and a full 40-prefix/task screen projected to 57.75 GPU-hours. One Rinse prefix nevertheless showed a one-to-two washed-region progress difference, motivating a bounded event-aligned B0.1 repair rather than calling the hypothesis refuted.
